summary: The full W20 stale adapter removes later published historical-calculation and snapshot identity fences. Preserve current 29997904 and add only W20 lifecycle/observation support.

findings.fact: W20 removes exact stored scenario result/case-incarnation/version validation plus the independently admitted historical calculation read lease. The current code leaves the active selector unchanged and finishes the private lease.
findings.impact: The existing late historical-calculation path is not preserved by a whole-file W20 replacement. No new runtime reproduction or exploit is claimed.

findings.fact: W20 deletes the digest of captured snapshots fixed before asynchronous authorization/source reads and compares two values at the end instead.
findings.impact: This loses the published anti-alias fence for retained snapshots across awaits. The proposed merge retains the original digest comparison. Runtime alias reachability was not executed in this audit.

findings.fact: W20 removes the current case id equality check while reading the entry by case key.
findings.impact: Retain id, incarnation, participant and integer/version checks together; no reason exists to weaken them for lifecycle support.

findings.fact: The current wrapper drops the fourth stale observation argument. W20 captures/freezes/forwards it and routes lifecycle markStale/terminal transitions through the lifecycle commit authority, while refusing preserveStale content on a lifecycle frame.
findings.impact: These deltas are required; retaining the old adapter unchanged would not install the intended stale observation/lifecycle semantics.

invariants: Only lifecycle import/optional argument plus W20 final wrapStore block differ from 29997904.
Historical calculations, private temporary read lease, snapshot digest, case identity, source access/revocation and cancellation code remain byte-identical.
Lifecycle does not accept fresh output, AlternativeDraft, ready/running/admission, human approval or cancellation authority.
markStale observation is cloned/frozen before awaited store work and exact durable run/output CAS remains owned by the current run-store.

requiredVerification: W20 lifecycle after source loss/case advance: terminal metadata can settle under current authority; output read, fresh content publication, AlternativeDraft, preparing/ready and analysis.start cancellation remain denied.

Observation forwarding: mutate caller observation during await; exactly the originally observed ready run may become stale, stored output bytes remain unchanged; missing/wrong digest/version/cancelled predecessor is refused.

Historical calculation: preserve same-case original-version late result through real BCS/C08 without updating the active selector; refuse other case/incarnation and result created after original case version.
Captured snapshot mutation or replacement during async authorization/source reads must fail the pinned snapshot digest before commit.
Revoked membership, host lease, request, source permission and cancellation provenance must remain refusals. Use existing real authority/persistence boundaries and no permissive source verifier.
Current own analysis-port47e25de4, readerdb9faeec and all current cancellation/egress tests remain preserved; no old owner test snapshot replacement.

criteriaAffected.disposition: Potential boundary evidence after owner publication and hosted tests only. No criterion is marked PASS by this static finding; T04.CHK.01 still needs a true inference race.
C07 installed publication can gain real installation evidence; absent native port/knowledge/model remains outside acceptance.
